candidate.name: David Voyles
candidate.headline: Senior Technical PM · Platform APIs · Entitlements · AI Agents

summary.text: Senior technical PM who takes platform capabilities from design to GA and retention: entitlements, publishing pipelines, and API contracts shared by 8 partner systems. Runs a personal fleet of AI agents with local and cloud models and live evals. Earlier career as a senior software engineer at Microsoft CSE and Comcast, and a technical evangelist teaching SDK and platform patterns.

jobs.title: Agentic Platforms
bullets: Authored a portable coding-agent playbook: versioned adapters any git repo can stamp, fail-closed receipted gates, and a machine layer that dispatches isolated agent sessions; personal infrastructure, not a customer product.
Run an agentic workflow of personalized agents with A/B testing of local and cloud models (167 skills, 57 commands, live evals); operated, never authored.
Gated routing and tool-call changes with live evals on every request plus CI replay, so the running stack fails closed before a bad change lands.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Partner Center / Xbox
bullets: Established bi-directional Multiplatform Entitlement sync between Xbox Live and Battle.net for the Activision Blizzard acquisition; Buy Once Play Anywhere licensing surfaced in systems publishers and players already used, not a new storefront.
Automated publisher onboarding via Event Grid so entitlements showed up in Battle.net without a side process, cutting manual configuration latency by 90%.

Designed Game Reparenting Validate / Execute Reparent APIs so 8 partner systems kept their existing tools through ownership transfers; Saga compensating transactions; 100% data fidelity, zero rollbacks.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Co-designed streaming data pipelines and ML models with NBA, NASCAR, Johnson & Johnson, and financial partners.
Delivered as a senior IC with stakeholders in the room, then shipped the APIs and pipelines those teams kept.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Built and owned the Xfinity on Xbox One frontend as sole developer; shipped marquee OTT playback on console as a single-owner delivery.

skills: Atomic APIs, modular publishing, Entitlements and Event Grid integrations, 8 partner systems
Local and cloud models, A/B testing, live evals on every request, CI replay
Led Fast Game Package Publishing; AI telemetry pipeline
